description: Unified Admin UI + IAM + JWT + Basic Auth + API Keys for multi-tenant Dynamic CRUD API platforms. v1.9.3 fixes a page-load crash on /admin/apiclients: leftover dead code called addEventListener on a non-existent 'clientTenant' element (the real field is 'acTen'), throwing on every load and silently breaking the Create/Regenerate buttons since neither ever finished wiring up. v1.9.2 stops showing the Config Editor link on the Databases page until a config actually exists — before that, only "⚡ Generate Config" is shown, since regenerating an already-published config is now a confirmed, deliberate action taken inside the Editor itself, not a one-click button here; Generate Config also gets a visible progress overlay (spinner, elapsed clock, phase text) instead of a single toast during what can be a long-running AI pipeline call. v1.9.1 adds a "Config" status badge and a "⚡ Generate/Regenerate Config" action to the Databases page (backed by a new cache-only config_generated_at column — never authoritative, the Config Editor always reads git directly), and a configurable GitHub Integration "Config path prefix" field alongside Owner/Repo/Token. v1.9.0 adds a signed per-database cross-app handoff and a "🎨 Config Editor" button on the Databases page for WebSvc.ConfigVisualizer, the new tenant dashboard config JSON editor. v1.8.0 rounds out the Tenant Portal's self-service database registration: fixes the platform-admin "Test Connection" button (it called a route that was never mapped), adds a matching tenant-side pre-registration test endpoint, returns a clean 409 on a duplicate database key instead of a raw SQL exception, and adds additive stateless Authorization: Bearer API-key auth to /api/tenant/* for server-to-server callers, alongside the existing cookie login. v1.7.0 opens cross-app handoff links in a new tab, adds a general (non-per-database) SqliteAdmin handoff, lets a Global Admin set/change a database's owning tenant from the Edit modal, and materializes RateLimitAdmin's per-database row immediately on handoff instead of waiting for real traffic. v1.6.0 added a signed cross-app handoff (CrossAppHandoffService) and a plain-string caller-identity bridge so independent add-on packages (e.g. WebSvc.RateLimitAdmin) can offer one-click auto-login and per-request identity without any compiled dependency on this package.
